# Exhaustive pad-to-net assertions for FaultyCat.kicad_pcb
#
# Generated from the PCB by `make extract-pcb-tests`.
# Verify that it is current with `make verify-pcb-tests`.
# Run the assertions with `make pcb-tests`.
#
# Extraction baseline:
#   - 136 total footprint objects
#   - 94 annotated electrical footprints
#   - 349 physical pads on those footprints
#   - 320 distinct REF:PAD assertions
#   - 10 pads excluded because their footprint or pad is unannotated
#
# Repeated physical pads sharing one pad number produce one assertion. Exact
# autogenerated Net-(...) names are intentional; only a true pad with no net
# is written as <no-net>.
#
# This proves assigned PCB pad/net topology. It does not prove component
# values, electrical limits, signal integrity, power sequencing, assembly
# quality, or safe target behavior.
